rules.title: Strict mode
rules.text: Enable "strict" in tsconfig and keep it on.

rules.title: No any
rules.text: Do not use any; use unknown and narrow, or model the type properly.

rules.title: Prefer unions over enums
rules.text: Prefer string literal unions over enums.

rules.title: Validate external data
rules.text: Validate untrusted data at runtime with a schema library instead of casting.

rules.title: Avoid non-null assertions
rules.text: Avoid non-null assertions (!) and unchecked type assertions (as).
